_note: ACMI Cloud plans. Follows docs/PRICING.md (Mikey's ruling of 2026-10-13: Free/Dev/Pro/Team/Agency/Enterprise). Limits are per op per calendar month (UTC). null means unlimited. 'read' is counted but never refused. Free is one tenth of the fleet's real monthly use (Mikey's ruling of 2026-10-20): 1,000 adds, 2 agents, 100 recalls. Paid plans follow ladder A (Mikey's ruling of 2026-10-21): Dev 10k, Pro 50k, Team 150k, Agency 500k adds, with recall at 10:1. Change numbers here, not in code.

aliases._note: PRD names (Starter/Scale) kept only as aliases.

free.name: Free
free._note: One tenth of the fleet's measured use, Mikey's ruling of 2026-10-20. The fleet (space madez) wrote 2,183 entries in the 7 days to Oct 21 (about 9,360 a month), with 15 agents and 1 space. So Free is 1,000 adds, 2 agents and 1 space. Recalls are not logged, so recall keeps the 10:1 add-to-recall ratio: 100. No overage: writes refused after the 10% grace.

dev.name: Dev
dev._note: Ladder A (Mikey, Oct 21): 10x Free. No overage: writes refused after the 10% grace (upgrade).

pro.name: Pro
pro._note: Ladder A (Mikey, Oct 21). The fleet today (about 29k a month) fits Pro. Overage billed (~$2 / 10k), never refused.

team.name: Team
team._note: Ladder A (Mikey, Oct 21). Overage billed (~$2 / 10k), never refused. agents null = unlimited.

agency.name: Agency
agency._note: Ladder A (Mikey, Oct 21). Overage billed (~$1.50 / 10k), never refused. 30 client spaces.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise._note: Custom contract. Limits null = unlimited; set per contract.
